release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.3 (Build 66): Modern Floating Capsule Bottom Navigation Bar & Mobile Engine Hardening.
• Floating Capsule Navigation: Floating stadium pill navigation bar with active grey pill selection capsule, filled cobalt blue active icons, outline dark slate inactive tabs, and notification badge cutout ring.
• Real-Time Data Synchronization: Full live backend integration without mock datasets across student, parent, and admin consoles.
• Fluid Screen Transitions: Centralized tactile animations and smooth skeleton loading screens app-wide.
